salesCommon.readOnly: Read-only view: you can look, not change.
salesCommon.noCompany: No company yet. Admin adds companies on Admin → Companies.

md.rule: Only the MD gives an exception, never the person who took the order. It names the amount and ends by itself; it is logged.
md.granted: MD exception recorded. A held order can now be released by someone other than its creator.
md.grantedReleased: MD exception recorded and the order now fits: it is confirmed.

exposure.gstOnly: Figures are GST bills only. The decision always uses the full exposure.
exposure.hiddenItems: Some items are not shown in your view. The decision uses the full exposure, so the customer may be blocked even when the figures look fine.
exposure.rule: Only cleared payments, allocated advances and posted credit notes free up credit. The server checks again at release, dispatch and billing.

line.enterHint: Enter in the last box adds a line. Tax and totals come from the server.

order.channel: That sales channel is not known.
order.payment: Payment is credit, cash or advance.
order.no_rate: Give a rate, or choose a price list that has this item.
order.no_price_list: This item is not on the customer's price list. Ask the office.
order.price_locked: Prices come from the price list and cannot be changed here.
order.discount_over_authority: This discount is above your authority. Ask the sales manager.
order.kyc_cash_only: The customer's KYC is not complete: cash or advance orders only.
order.private_label_pending: The private-label approvals are not complete.
order.state: That order is not in a state for this step.
order.not_confirmed: The order is not confirmed yet.

credit.over_limit: Still over the credit limit. An MD exception by another person is needed.
credit.exception_until: An MD exception needs an end time in the future.
credit.exception_amount: The exception amount must be above zero.
credit.application_open: An application for this customer is already in progress.
credit.limit_amount: Ask for a limit above zero.
credit.wrong_stage: This application is waiting for another stage.
credit.same_person: You already decided an earlier stage of this application. Another person decides this one.
credit.kyc_not_verified: Verify the customer's KYC before the credit file is verified.
credit.review_date: The MD sets a review date in the future.
credit.status: Credit status is active, hold or review.
credit.no_approval: Credit becomes active only through an approved application.

complaint.lot: That batch is not of this company.
complaint.status: Status is investigating, resolved or rejected.
complaint.not_alone: The person who logged a complaint cannot close it. Someone else closes it.
complaint.hold_open: QC must decide the batch hold first.

private_label.stage: The stage is sales, quality or MD.
private_label.same_person: Each approval comes from a different person.

shop.missing: That shop was not found or is not active.
shop.no_customer: Choose the customer, or set the shop's walk-in customer.
shop.branch: Choose a shop branch of this company.
shop.place: Choose a stock place of this shop.
shop.day_closed: This day is already closed for the shop.

export.missing: That export order was not found.
export.not_overseas: An export order is for an overseas buyer.
export.container_no: The container number or its check digit is wrong (4 letters, 7 digits).
export.lut_expired: Record a valid LUT for this date on the export order.

listing.blocked: This item cannot be listed yet.

online.unknown_item: An item in the order is not in the item master.

query.status: Status is open, in progress, answered or closed.
query.document: That document is not of this customer.

promise.date: The promised date cannot be in the past.

party.not_linked: This customer is not linked to the company.

sod.own_request: Someone else must approve or release what you asked for or entered.

stock.lot_on_hold: A batch on QC hold cannot be sold.
stock.insufficient: Not enough stock at this place.

qc.already_on_hold: This batch is already on hold.

gst.without_admin_only: An export under LUT (without GST) is posted by Admin only.

rights.reason_required: Give a reason (at least five letters).
rights.missing: You do not have the right for this. Ask Admin.

price.above_mrp: A price including tax is above the item's MRP.

money.account: Set the shop's cash or bank account first.

date.future: The date is in the future.
